name: amiberry
description:
Amiberry lets you experience the Commodore Amiga, a legendary home computer
from the late 1980s and 1990s known for its groundbreaking graphics, sound,
and gaming library.

Emulate a wide range of Amiga models, from the classic A500 to the powerful
A4000. Play thousands of games, run productivity software, or explore the
demoscene — all with accurate hardware emulation and modern conveniences like
save states, shader effects, and gamepad support.

Features include a built-in game launcher for easy one-click play, customizable
controls, support for multiple disk image formats, and a full-featured settings
interface for fine-tuning every aspect of the emulated hardware.
